YOLO mode is turned on from the ADBuddy app on the phone, for 15 minutes, 1 hour
or until the session ends: while it is on, the agent works without asking you to
confirm anything, and nothing blocks it except the pause. `off` turns it off and
`status` says whether it is on. There is no `on`: only the phone can turn it on.

Usage:
  adbuddy yolo off|status [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy yolo status
  adbuddy yolo off

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for yolo

Global Flags:
      --json   machine-readable JSON output, for the commands that support it
